metrics.volumeHelp: Volume covers the latest trading session represented in the chart, rather than the total for the selected chart range.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Bring your holdings into one private workspace. Start with a Wealthsimple CSV.
resources.vaultHelp: Sign in to find your library. Use your device passkey to unlock its contents.
resources.notConfigured: Holdings storage is not enabled in this environment yet. You can still follow the export guide.
resources.signInHelp: Sign in with Google before creating or opening your private resource library.
resources.createHelp: Set up a passkey to protect your holdings. Your device handles the confirmation; there are no key files to manage.
resources.passkeyHelp: Your browser and password manager must support secure passkey unlocking. Unsupported devices cannot upload unencrypted holdings.
resources.unlockHelp: Your holdings stay hidden until you confirm with your passkey. Google sign-in alone does not unlock them.
resources.chooseHelp: Choose the Wealthsimple holdings CSV you downloaded. Review accounts and values before saving.
resources.fileLimit: CSV up to 4 MB · Parsed on your device
resources.pendingHelp: An encrypted upload is awaiting confirmation. Retrying sends the original encrypted snapshot; it does not create a different upload.
resources.totalsHelp: Totals include imported position values and verified reported cash. Currencies stay separate; missing values are not treated as zero.
resources.noSupportedPositions: No supported security positions in this account. Check any reported cash and excluded rows.
resources.excludedSummary: {count} rows were excluded. This snapshot does not represent those assets.
resources.cashHelp: Reported cash is not a confirmed withdrawable balance or buying power. Unknown cash stays unknown.
resources.confirmHelp: Review the notes: selected accounts become a new encrypted snapshot, replacing this source’s current view while keeping saved history.
resources.guideIntro: Use Wealthsimple on a computer. The holdings report is a snapshot for the date and accounts you select.
resources.reportHelp: Activity, tax and realized gain/loss reports describe different data and cannot replace a holdings report.
resources.compatibility: This importer matches a supplied 21-column Wealthsimple export. Changed or unknown columns stop the import for review; this is not an official Wealthsimple integration.
resources.privacyHelp: The file is read and previewed on your device. Holdings are encrypted before saving. Locking or signing out removes the decrypted view.
resources.passkeyRecovery: Keep access to your system passkey. If every usable passkey is lost, the platform cannot decrypt your library for you.

guide.login: Sign in to Wealthsimple in your web browser.
guide.documents: Open Profile in the lower-left corner, then Documents.
guide.date: Choose the As of date, then Next.
guide.accounts: Select the accounts you want to include.
guide.download: Choose Download CSV, then return here to select the file.

notices.vault_created: Your encrypted library is ready. You can now choose a CSV.
notices.saved: Your encrypted snapshot was saved and its receipt verified.
notices.receipt_recovered: The saved receipt was recovered and verified. Cloud history was kept.
notices.retry_discarded: The local retry was removed. Cloud history was not deleted; you can choose a CSV for a new import.

errors.generic: This step could not be completed. Reload the library status and try again.
errors.request_failed: Could not complete the request. Your existing encrypted data is unchanged.
errors.service_unavailable: The private storage service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.version_conflict: The library changed during this operation. Reload its status before trying again.
errors.session_expired: Your sign-in session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.insufficient_scope: This operation is not currently authorized. Reload the library status.
errors.invalid_response: The library response could not be verified. No unverified holdings will be displayed.
errors.request_timeout: The operation took too long and the library was locked. Unlock it again to recover any encrypted upload.
errors.unlock_required: Unlock your resource library before continuing.
errors.passkey_unsupported: This browser or password manager does not support the required passkey protection. Try a supported device; unencrypted upload is unavailable.
errors.passkey_cancelled: Passkey confirmation was cancelled. Choose unlock or setup again when you are ready.
errors.unlock_failed: The passkey could not unlock this library. Use the passkey that created it.
errors.invalid_data: The encrypted library data could not be verified.
errors.choose_file: Choose and review a holdings CSV first.
errors.file_too_large: Choose a CSV smaller than 4 MB.
errors.field_too_large: A CSV field is too large to import safely.
errors.unsupported_headers: The columns do not match the supported Wealthsimple holdings report. Export Holdings report (CSV), keeping its original columns.
errors.unsupported_broker: This broker’s import format is not supported yet.
errors.invalid_csv: The CSV contains malformed quoting or invalid characters. Export a fresh copy and try again.
errors.invalid_row_width: A row has an unexpected number of columns. Export a fresh holdings report.
errors.invalid_number: A required number could not be read exactly. Review the indicated row.
errors.number_out_of_range: A number exceeds the supported precision or size. No rounded value was imported.
errors.total_out_of_range: The reported total exceeds the supported range.
errors.invalid_field: A required field is missing or invalid.
errors.invalid_market_value: A long security position has an invalid negative market value.
errors.invalid_report_date: The report footer date could not be verified.
errors.too_many_rows: This CSV exceeds the import row limit. Split it into smaller holdings reports.
errors.too_many_accounts: Import at most 10 accounts at a time.
errors.too_many_positions: An account contains too many positions for one snapshot.
errors.resource_too_large: The selected holdings exceed the encrypted snapshot limit. Export fewer accounts or positions.
errors.invalid_account_selection: Keep at least one available account selected.
errors.crypto_unavailable: Secure browser encryption is unavailable. Use a secure supported browser.
errors.too_many_exclusions: Too many rows are unsupported for one import.
errors.untrusted_vault: The library identity differs from this device’s record. Opening or replacing it was blocked. Check your account and reload the library status.

warnings.manual_snapshot: This is a manual snapshot, not a live broker connection.
warnings.account_coverage_unverified: Only accounts included in this file are covered; other broker accounts are not verified.
warnings.valuation_timestamp_unknown: The report date does not establish an exact valuation timestamp.
warnings.buying_power_unknown: Buying power is not supplied by this import.
warnings.cash_balance_unknown: Cash was not verified for one or more currencies; it remains unknown.
warnings.accounts_not_selected: Unselected accounts will not be included in the saved snapshot.
warnings.unsupported_security_type: Unsupported asset rows were excluded, including crypto or derivatives.
warnings.unsupported_currency: Rows in unsupported currencies were excluded.
warnings.unknown_position_direction: Rows with an unrecognized position direction were excluded.
warnings.cash_balance_unverified: A currency row could not be verified as native-currency cash and was excluded.
warnings.negative_cash_balance: A negative reported cash balance was retained as a liability.
warnings.duplicate_cash_row: Identical duplicate cash rows were counted once.
warnings.duplicate_position_row: Identical duplicate security rows were counted once.
warnings.exchange_unknown: An exchange is missing for a position.
warnings.market_value_unknown: A market value or its currency was not supplied; no zero was substituted.
warnings.market_value_currency_differs: A reported market value uses a different currency from its security; totals follow the value’s currency.

resources.reading: Reading and decrypting your saved holdings…
resources.recoverOrDiscard: Resolve local retry and import again
resources.discardHelp: No saved receipt was returned. Discard only this device’s retry packet? A request already sent may still be saved later. This will not delete any cloud snapshot or history. Choose the CSV again for a new import.
resources.importScope: Saves selected accounts, securities, quantities, currencies, reported values and verified cash. Unit prices, book costs, returns and the report date are not retained yet. The original CSV is not uploaded.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Receive and revisit your agents’ work in one private place.
inbox.unavailable: Inbox access is not available for this instance yet. Markets and your other tools are still available.
inbox.signInHelp: Sign in to see results from your own connected agents.
inbox.createHelp: Use a Passkey to protect the library that holds your resources and agent results.
inbox.unlockHelp: Use the same Passkey as your resources. Titles and report text are decrypted only on your device.
inbox.pendingHelp: The response was lost. Retry the exact saved change to recover its acknowledgement, or discard the local retry and refresh.
inbox.searchScope: Search only checks reports you have opened in this loaded view. Unopened or unloaded reports are not searched.
inbox.lockedScope: Titles, summaries and report text stay hidden until you unlock.
inbox.openToDecrypt: Open to check and decrypt this report.
inbox.unlockToRead: Unlock your library to read this report.
inbox.emptyTitle: A little room for your next insight
inbox.emptyHelp: Results from your connected agents will arrive here. Refresh to check for updates.
inbox.copyWarning: Copying exports the decrypted report as plain text to your clipboard. Other apps may be able to read it.
inbox.copyFailed: Clipboard access is unavailable. Your report has not been copied.
inbox.historicalHelp: You are reading a saved historical revision. Opening it does not mark the latest revision as read.
inbox.citationHelp: Links and conclusions are provided by the agent. No linked page is loaded until you choose to open it.
inbox.evidenceHelp: The signature identifies your approved connection. It does not verify the agent’s analysis or identify the model it used.
inbox.frozenHelp: These versions belong to this saved run. They do not change when your current resources change, or prove that the agent considered every input.
inbox.noFrozenInputs: This task used no resource inputs.
inbox.historyHelp: Each revision keeps its own signed content and original input evidence.
inbox.selectTitle: A clear view of your agents’ work
inbox.selectHelp: Open a result to read its report, check its sources and revisit earlier revisions.
inbox.privacy: Your Passkey protects the content. The platform stores encrypted reports.

errors.invalid_response: The response could not be checked. Refresh and try again.
errors.service_unavailable: Your inbox is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.session_expired: Your sign-in session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.insufficient_scope: Your current authorization does not allow this action. Refresh or enable changes on this device.
errors.version_conflict: This result changed while you were reading it. Refresh before making another change.
errors.request_timeout: The request took too long. Refresh to check the latest state.
errors.unlock_required: Unlock your library to read or change this result.
errors.verification_failed: This report could not be authenticated or decrypted. Its private content has not been displayed.
errors.render_rejected: This report contains unsupported or unsafe content and cannot be displayed.
errors.not_found: This saved result or revision is no longer available to this account.
errors.pending_state: Resolve the saved change before starting another one.
errors.state_outcome_unknown: We could not confirm whether the change was saved. Use the saved retry to check it safely.
errors.passkey_unsupported: This browser or Passkey does not support private library unlock. Try a supported local browser.
errors.passkey_cancelled: Passkey confirmation was cancelled. Try again when you are ready.
errors.unlock_failed: The library could not be unlocked with this Passkey.
errors.wrong_account: This library belongs to a different account.
errors.untrusted_vault: The library’s identity could not be verified. Its content stays locked.
errors.request_failed: The action could not be completed. Refresh and try again.

notices.state_conflict: A newer result or state is available. Refresh before changing it.
notices.state_recovered: The original saved change was confirmed.
notices.no_loaded_match: No opened reports in this loaded view match your search.
notices.new_results: New results or changes are available. Refresh to start an updated inbox view.

inbox.readOnlyHelp: You can read saved reports. Use your Passkey to authorize this device before changing their status.
inbox.stateScope: Read, star and archive apply to this result across all its revisions.
